RESULT [selftrain]: Add_Data scenario on MASSIVE: negative flip rate falls from 2.8% (new model) to 1.4% (BCWI) at the same 83.4% accuracy. The authors report up to 3x fewer negative flips across their datasets. This is NLP classification, not detection.
US [selftrain]: This gives the incremental loop a sharper metric than 'did holdout mAP drop'. Count per-image or per-species regressions (negative flips) between round k and k+1 on the sealed holdout, and use weight interpolation as a soft rollback. Transfer to YOLO detection is untested.
